test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"fit."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Fit"** means to be suitable or appropriate for a particular purpose or situation, to be the right size or shape for somebody/something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के लिए आकार या बनावट में एकदम सही होना; उचित होना)

 
 
• **Example**:* The dress fits perfectly for the party tonight.*
 
 
 
• The goal of solving a puzzle is to logically put the pieces together to get the right answer or a fun way to solve the problem. 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

A puzzle is a game, challenge, or toy that tests__ one’s inventiveness or knowledge. The solver of a puzzle is supposed to __**fit**__ parts together logically to arrive at the correct or enjoyable solution to the challenge. Crossword puzzles, word-search puzzles, number puzzles, relational puzzles, and logic puzzles are examples of puzzle ______ (3) ______. Puzzles are frequently developed for fun purposes, but they may also result from ______ (4) ______ mathematical or logical challenges. In such circumstances, its answer might make an important ______ (5) ______ to mathematical research. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Manifest"** means to display or show (a quality or feeling) by one's acts or appearance. (किसी के कार्यों या दिखावे से (किसी गुण या भावना को) प्रदर्शित करना या प्रदर्शित करना)
 
• **"Disintegrate"** means to break up into small parts or lose cohesion. (टुकड़े-टुकड़े हो जाना, विखंडित होना, विघटित होना)
 
• **"Paste" **means to stick something to something else using paste or a similar substance (glue). (लेई या गोंद से एक वस्‍तु को दूसरी से चिपकाना)
